title: Use the Surrender Tactic: Transform Weakness into Power
coreMove: Yield in a way that absorbs force and preserves the next opening
sourcePressure: Chapter 22 is supported here by the frozen title and grouped secondary summaries: tactical surrender can absorb force, reduce damage, and create a later opening when direct resistance would strengthen the stronger side. The mechanism should stay narrow. The chapter is about yielding, overextension, delayed reversal, and preserved initiative, not about glorifying helplessness or passive defeat. Keep it grounded in force absorption, timing, and the limit that surrender only works when it protects future agency. Frozen sidecar provides no traceable named anecdote for this chapter; do not fabricate named source anchors.
